blocks.content: • Low pension penetration in informal sector.
Low pension penetration in informal sector.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: PFRDA faces significant hurdles in expanding pension coverage to workers in the informal sector.
A widespread lack of financial literacy hinders public understanding and adoption of pension products.
Pension returns remain exposed to market fluctuations and associated risks.
Identify the informal sector as the primary segment suffering from low pension coverage under PFRDA initiatives.
Remember that returns under market-linked pension schemes managed by PFRDA are not guaranteed and carry market risks.
